title: Why Does Time Speed Up as You Get Older?
premise: A repeating birthday gives way to a week of distinct memories.

scenes.anchor: Blow, reset, blow again; 26 appears on the cake.
scenes.label: candle

scenes.anchor: A friend's message interrupts a December evening.
scenes.label: text

scenes.anchor: The childhood camera roll is full of distinct memories.
scenes.label: camera-2008

scenes.anchor: This year's camera roll has 11 mostly repetitive screenshots.
scenes.label: camera-2026

scenes.anchor: The empty-year realization settles on his face.
scenes.label: cant-name-one

scenes.anchor: The same laptop fills the frame.
scenes.label: same-laptop

scenes.anchor: Attention shifts to the same ordinary meal.
scenes.label: same-food

scenes.anchor: The same phone scroll completes the routine.
scenes.label: same-scroll

scenes.anchor: Childhood jars hold a first swim, first bike and bee sting.
scenes.label: child-memories

scenes.anchor: One work jar compresses a repetitive year.
scenes.label: adult-memory

scenes.anchor: An exact 20% slice becomes 2%; one theory, not proof.
scenes.label: small-piece

scenes.anchor: He puts the camera roll down and chooses to change the week.
scenes.label: try-something

scenes.anchor: Five empty jars wait for five selected days from his week.
scenes.label: one-new-thing

scenes.anchor: A new path leads through an unfamiliar amber street.
scenes.label: day-1

scenes.anchor: He takes a bite and smiles at the unfamiliar food.
scenes.label: day-2

scenes.anchor: A short feet-first jump ends in a cold splash.
scenes.label: day-3

scenes.anchor: He reconnects with Grandma on the phone.
scenes.label: day-4

scenes.anchor: He sits safely on a rooftop as the sun rises.
scenes.label: day-5

scenes.anchor: The shelf now contains five distinct moments from the week.
scenes.label: week-shelf

scenes.anchor: The contrast is named: fast now, longer in memory.
scenes.label: holiday-paradox

scenes.anchor: His child self climbs up once and sits beside him.
scenes.label: kid-returns

scenes.anchor: The candle remains lit; the picture returns to the opening.
scenes.label: candle-stays
